0022600155.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-4, 12th in the East, 3 games back in the Central) have lost three straight and are 0-2 at home, while the Brooklyn Nets (0-5, 15th in the East, 4.5 games back in the Atlantic) have dropped five in a row. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Pacers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 136-109 win in Brooklyn on October 25, and they won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
